column4: Flat side view of large black dressmaker shears lying horizontally across the frame, lying flat in the picture plane, the pivot screw at the right third, handles off the right edge, the two straight blades opening to the left in a wide V. A thick bundle of many taut tan-gold strings hangs straight down from the top edge to the bottom edge and passes through the throat of the V right next to the pivot: in front of the far blade, behind the near blade, squeezed between the two cutting edges. Flat empty ivory background. No hand, no text.

Full-body view of the same brand-new porcelain maid doll as in the references, being lowered fast from above on strings: eyes closed, head slightly bowed, both arms lifted a little away from the body at the wrists as if held by strings, toes pointing straight down, her skirt, apron and long orange hair lifted and floating upward from the fast descent. Same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand. Front view, the whole figure fits the frame with a small margin. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140), no strings, no floor, no shadow, no text.

Full-body view of the same brand-new porcelain maid doll as in the references, at the instant she lands: eyes closed, head dropped forward, both knees softly bent from the impact, boot tips just touching down, arms swung slightly forward and limp, her skirt and apron flared wide outward like a bell, long orange hair falling down around her shoulders. Same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings.
